design.title: Design system
design.intro: Every primitive in one place, in the adviser register. Check it at 360 px before building a screen — and look here before building a component that may already exist.
design.colourNote: Amber is decorative only; amber-toned text uses the xp-ink token. Category colours identify, never rank.
design.fieldHint: As written on your class list.
design.fieldError: Only a School Admin can change your section.
design.textareaHint: Shown to the officer who proposed the event.
design.checkboxHint: You can change this at any time.
design.toastFailed: That code could not be read. Try again.
design.cardBody: A card carries one subject. Everything an adviser needs in order to decide belongs on it, so that deciding never means navigating away.
design.tabUpcomingBody: Tabs overflow sideways rather than shrinking, so a five-tab row stays readable at 360 px.
design.emptyDescription: Events appear here once they have finished and attendance has synced.
design.dialogDescription: The organizers will be notified and the event becomes visible to the whole school.
design.sheetBody: A bottom sheet opens where the thumb already is. Prefer it on a phone for anything with more than two controls.
design.artLevel: Level badges, frames, XP mark and podium
design.artAvatar: The curated set — no photo uploads exist
